blocks.content: Course: Make Your Website Interactive with JavaScript
The slider controls which project card is visible.
Now each card needs its own interaction.

items: A full description hidden by default

blocks.content: When the button is clicked, the full description should expand smoothly.
The interaction follows the same toggle pattern used earlier. When clicked:

items: Change the button text "Read more" when collapsed and "Show less" when expanded
Update the aria-expanded attribute to match the state

blocks.content: JavaScript only changes the state. CSS handles the smooth max-height transition.
The Case Study and Live Demo links remain normal links. There is no modal and no navigation change.
This behavior should work independently for each project card.

items: Loop over all cards and attach listeners
Or attach one listener per button
